subject: Quick follow-up: hosted eval quickstart & endpoint/rate clarification
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Li <jamie@cedartech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: hosted eval quickstart & endpoint/rate clarification

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few items we need to size the hosted eval sandbox: 

1) Traffic profile: can you confirm expected concurrent requests at peak and typical burst behavior? (e.g., sustained 2 RPS, bursts to 10 RPS for short windows)
2) Payloads: average prompt length and expected response length (tokens)
3) Data residency: any hard requirements for region or VPC?
4) Success criteria for the eval: latency SLOs, cost targets, and the length of the trial period

Proposed quickstart: we can provision a sandbox host endpoint (hosted API) with a conservative rate cap (10 rps per endpoint, shared quota) and a pre-populated prompt set so you can validate latency and quality in ~2 business days. Attached is a short ops primer and our pricing sheet (high level).

Next steps: if you can reply with the profile above, I’ll loop in our pricing lead and solutions engineer and we’ll send a one-page test plan + endpoints. Also putting procurement on copy if you want a formal quote.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- redwood-quickstart-ops.pdf (ops checklist)
- redwood-pricing-sheet-2026.xlsx (summary pricing)

From: Jamie Li <jamie@cedartech.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: CedarTech Procurement <procurement@cedartech.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: hosted eval quickstart & endpoint/rate clarification

Thanks, Sergio — great session. Answers below: 

- Peak concurrency: expected ~5 RPS for the main generation endpoint during business hours; spikes up to ~12 RPS for 10–15 minute windows when large batches run.
- Avg prompt length: ~120 tokens; avg response target ~160 tokens (generation).
- Residency: no immediate legal residency requirement — US region is fine for the eval. If we move to production, we may require dedicated capacity or VPC depending on data classification.
- Success criteria: P95 latency <300ms for single-turn inference at the 5 RPS sustained profile, and output quality passing our 10-case prompt set. Trial length: 2 weeks preferred.

Procurement — appreciate if you can confirm what docs you need; Sergio mentioned SOC 2 and an initial quote. Happy to jump on a short call with pricing/legal if useful.

Best,
Jamie Li
Senior Product Manager — CedarTech
jamie@cedartech.com

Quick internal note + reply to procurement and Jamie: 

Thanks for the detail, Jamie — very helpful. Sergio / Lauren / Marissa — proposed response below (I will send after we align):

1) SOC2 & docs: attaching SOC2 summary and the vendor security pack (SOC2-summary.pdf).
2) Data handling: during the hosted eval we retain request/response logs for 30 days by default; KV cache is ephemeral and only used to speed inference; we can opt out of KV caching for the eval if CedarTech prefers.
3) SLA: hosted API baseline SLA is 99.9% monthly uptime; for Dedicated we can discuss a higher SLA and a capacity commit.
4) Pricing / quote: I’ll attach a short one-page quote with two lines: Hosted eval (sandbox) — complimentary trial for 2 weeks at limited rate (10 RPS soft cap) and a representative monthly price for Dedicated reserved pool (est. numbers in pricing sheet).
5) Activation timeline: we can spin up the hosted sandbox endpoints within 48 hours after confirm, subject to account onboarding and keys.

Action items: Sergio — confirm you’re happy with the response and I’ll send to procurement + Jamie. Lauren — do you want the engineering touchpoint on KV cache opt-out? Marissa — please verify the price figures in the attached pricing-sheet.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
